foto_lokasi_check.name: foto_lokasi_check
foto_lokasi_check.value:
("foto"."latitude" IS NULL AND "foto"."longitude" IS NULL AND "foto"."akurasi_meter" IS NULL)
    OR ("foto"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "foto"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "foto"."akurasi_meter" IS NOT NULL
      AND "foto"."latitude" BETWEEN -11 AND 6 AND "foto"."longitude" BETWEEN 95 AND 141
      AND "foto"."akurasi_meter" > 0)

hari_kolektor_absensi_check.name: hari_kolektor_absensi_check

        OR ("hari_kolektor"."absensi" = 'tidak_kerja' AND "hari_kolektor"."alasan_tidak_kerja" IS NOT NULL
          AND "hari_kolektor"."kas_lapangan" = 0 AND "hari_kolektor"."uang_jalan" = 0
          AND "hari_kolektor"."laporan_dibuka_at" IS NULL AND "hari_kolektor"."transfer_lama" IS NULL)

hari_kolektor_nominal_check.name: hari_kolektor_nominal_check
hari_kolektor_nominal_check.value:
"hari_kolektor"."kas_lapangan" >= 0 AND "hari_kolektor"."uang_jalan" >= 0
        AND ("hari_kolektor"."transfer_lama" IS NULL OR "hari_kolektor"."transfer_lama" >= 0)
        AND ("hari_kolektor"."tekor_lama" IS NULL OR "hari_kolektor"."tekor_lama" > 0)

mutasi_kas_kantor_akun_check.name: mutasi_kas_kantor_akun_check

("mutasi_kas_kantor"."jenis"::text IN ('setor_modal', 'lain_masuk')
          AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."ke_akun" IS NOT NULL AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."dari_akun" IS NULL)
        OR ("mutasi_kas_kantor"."jenis"::text IN ('tarik_modal', 'biaya_kantor', 'lain_keluar')
          AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."dari_akun" IS NOT NULL AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."ke_akun" IS NULL)
        OR ("mutasi_kas_kantor"."jenis"::text = 'pindah_akun'
          AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."dari_akun" IS NOT NULL AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."ke_akun" IS NOT NULL AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."dari_akun" <> "mutasi_kas_kantor"."ke_akun")

mutasi_kas_kantor_batal_check.name: mutasi_kas_kantor_batal_check

    OR ("mutasi_kas_kantor"."dibatalkan_at" IS NOT NULL AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."dibatalkan_oleh" IS NOT NULL AND "mutasi_kas_kantor"."alasan_batal" IS NOT NULL)

("nasabah"."latitude" IS NULL AND "nasabah"."longitude" IS NULL AND "nasabah"."akurasi_meter" IS NULL)
    OR ("nasabah"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "nasabah"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "nasabah"."akurasi_meter" IS NOT NULL

      AND "nasabah"."akurasi_meter" > 0)

nasabah_blokir_check.name: nasabah_blokir_check

("nasabah"."diblokir_at" IS NULL AND "nasabah"."diblokir_oleh" IS NULL AND "nasabah"."alasan_blokir" IS NULL)

pembayaran_gaji_batal_check.name: pembayaran_gaji_batal_check
pembayaran_gaji_batal_check.value:
("pembayaran_gaji"."dibatalkan_at" IS NULL AND "pembayaran_gaji"."dibatalkan_oleh" IS NULL AND "pembayaran_gaji"."alasan_batal" IS NULL)
        OR ("pembayaran_gaji"."dibatalkan_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pembayaran_gaji"."dibatalkan_oleh" IS NOT NULL AND "pembayaran_gaji"."alasan_batal" IS NOT NULL)

generated.as: CASE WHEN peran = 'kolektor' THEN kantor_id END

pengguna_peran_check.name: pengguna_peran_check
pengguna_peran_check.value:
("pengguna"."peran" = 'bos' AND "pengguna"."nomor_hp" IS NOT NULL AND "pengguna"."hash_sandi" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pengguna"."peran" <> 'bos' AND "pengguna"."hash_sandi" IS NULL)

pengguna_nonaktif_check.name: pengguna_nonaktif_check
pengguna_nonaktif_check.value:
("pengguna"."dinonaktifkan_at" IS NULL AND "pengguna"."dinonaktifkan_oleh" IS NULL AND "pengguna"."alasan_nonaktif" IS NULL)
        OR ("pengguna"."dinonaktifkan_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pengguna"."dinonaktifkan_oleh" IS NOT NULL AND "pengguna"."alasan_nonaktif" IS NOT NULL)

perangkat_putus_check.name: perangkat_putus_check
perangkat_putus_check.value:
("perangkat"."diputus_at" IS NULL AND "perangkat"."diputus_oleh" IS NULL AND "perangkat"."alasan_putus" IS NULL)
        OR ("perangkat"."diputus_at" IS NOT NULL AND "perangkat"."alasan_putus" IS NOT NULL
          AND ("perangkat"."alasan_putus" IN ('pakai_ulang', 'kedaluwarsa')) = ("perangkat"."diputus_oleh" IS NULL))

generated.as: CASE WHEN jenis = 'tempoan' THEN tanggal_akad + tenor END

pinjaman_tenor_check.name: pinjaman_tenor_check
pinjaman_tenor_check.value:
("pinjaman"."jenis" = 'harian' AND "pinjaman"."tenor" = 24)
        OR ("pinjaman"."jenis" = 'mingguan' AND "pinjaman"."tenor" IN (6, 8, 10))
        OR ("pinjaman"."jenis" = 'tempoan' AND "pinjaman"."tenor" IN (7, 10, 14))

pinjaman_nominal_check.name: pinjaman_nominal_check
pinjaman_nominal_check.value:
"pinjaman"."potongan_admin" >= 0 AND "pinjaman"."tabungan_masuk" >= 0 AND "pinjaman"."saldo_lama" >= 0
        AND "pinjaman"."pencairan" >= 0 AND "pinjaman"."drop_baru" >= 0 AND "pinjaman"."drop_gulung" >= 0
        AND "pinjaman"."pokok_berkurang" >= 0 AND "pinjaman"."total_kembali" >= "pinjaman"."pokok"

pinjaman_pencairan_check.name: pinjaman_pencairan_check
pinjaman_pencairan_check.value:
("pinjaman"."asal" = 'migrasi' AND "pinjaman"."pencairan" = 0 AND "pinjaman"."potongan_admin" = 0
          AND "pinjaman"."drop_baru" = 0 AND "pinjaman"."drop_gulung" = 0)
        OR ("pinjaman"."asal" <> 'migrasi' AND "pinjaman"."saldo_awal" = "pinjaman"."total_kembali" AND "pinjaman"."pencairan" > 0
          AND "pinjaman"."pencairan" = "pinjaman"."pokok" - "pinjaman"."potongan_admin" - "pinjaman"."tabungan_masuk" - "pinjaman"."saldo_lama"
          AND "pinjaman"."drop_baru" + "pinjaman"."drop_gulung" = "pinjaman"."pokok")

pinjaman_disalin_check.name: pinjaman_disalin_check
pinjaman_disalin_check.value:
("pinjaman"."asal" = 'migrasi' AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_disalin" IS NOT NULL AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_disalin" >= "pinjaman"."tanggal_akad")
        OR ("pinjaman"."asal" <> 'migrasi' AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_disalin" IS NULL)

pinjaman_gulung_check.name: pinjaman_gulung_check
pinjaman_gulung_check.value:
("pinjaman"."asal" = 'gulung' AND "pinjaman"."pinjaman_asal_id" IS NOT NULL AND "pinjaman"."jenis_gulung" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pinjaman"."asal" <> 'gulung' AND "pinjaman"."pinjaman_asal_id" IS NULL AND "pinjaman"."jenis_gulung" IS NULL
          AND "pinjaman"."saldo_lama" = 0 AND "pinjaman"."drop_gulung" = 0 AND "pinjaman"."pokok_berkurang" = 0)

pinjaman_status_check.name: pinjaman_status_check
pinjaman_status_check.value:
("pinjaman"."status" IN ('berjalan', 'macet') AND "pinjaman"."saldo" > 0 AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_selesai" IS NULL)
        OR ("pinjaman"."status" IN ('lunas', 'digulung') AND "pinjaman"."saldo" = 0 AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_selesai" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pinjaman"."status" = 'batal' AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_selesai" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pinjaman"."status" = 'diputihkan' AND "pinjaman"."saldo" > 0 AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_selesai" IS NOT NULL)

pinjaman_macet_check.name: pinjaman_macet_check
pinjaman_macet_check.value:
("pinjaman"."status" = 'macet' AND "pinjaman"."tanggal_macet" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pinjaman"."status" <> 'macet' AND ("pinjaman"."tanggal_macet" IS NULL OR "pinjaman"."status" = 'diputihkan'))

pinjaman_pemutihan_check.name: pinjaman_pemutihan_check
pinjaman_pemutihan_check.value:
("pinjaman"."status" = 'diputihkan' AND "pinjaman"."diputihkan_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pinjaman"."diputihkan_oleh" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pinjaman"."alasan_pemutihan" IS NOT NULL AND "pinjaman"."keterangan_pemutihan" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pinjaman"."status" <> 'diputihkan' AND "pinjaman"."diputihkan_at" IS NULL AND "pinjaman"."diputihkan_oleh" IS NULL
          AND "pinjaman"."alasan_pemutihan" IS NULL AND "pinjaman"."keterangan_pemutihan" IS NULL)

pinjaman_batal_check.name: pinjaman_batal_check
pinjaman_batal_check.value:
("pinjaman"."status" = 'batal' AND "pinjaman"."dibatalkan_at" IS NOT NULL AND "pinjaman"."dibatalkan_oleh" IS NOT NULL
          AND "pinjaman"."alasan_batal" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("pinjaman"."status" <> 'batal' AND "pinjaman"."dibatalkan_at" IS NULL AND "pinjaman"."dibatalkan_oleh" IS NULL
          AND "pinjaman"."alasan_batal" IS NULL)

tarif_gaji_tarif_check.name: tarif_gaji_tarif_check
